name: Collapse, Mass
body:
School transmutation; Level druid 9, sorcerer/wizard 8
Targets one living creature/2 levels (no two of which may be more than 30 feet apart)

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as collapse except it affects multiple creatures within range and the maximum falling damage dealt is 25d6.
